Subject: Initial allocation for Helio POC — request for expanded trial resources

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the quick onboarding. As we kicked off our Helio POC this morning, a couple of implementation details changed the expected consumption profile. We had planned for ~2k context windows but after an initial pass our core use-case needs 8k context windows for document-level retrieval + chain-of-thought traces. That increases tokens-per-minute (TPM) substantially.

Quick numbers:
- Expected burst TPM: ~22k
- Estimated daily tokens: 40k–70k (varies by dataset)
- POC duration: 14 days

Given that, the default free allowance is going to be exhausted in 2–3 days. Would Redwood be able to raise the initial trial/top-up allowance for Helio's self-serve signup so we have enough headroom to finish the evaluation? We prefer a self-serve promo or a voucher (so our infra team can consume without extra back-and-forth).

I've attached a short scope doc with queries and sample sizes. Happy to jump on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Thanks,
Evan
